description: This file is a test configuration script using pytest for a FastAPI application. It sets environment variables, defines fixtures for database setup and HTTP client overrides, and includes utility functions for testing user registration and authentication functionalities.

methods.name: db_engine()
methods.description: Provides a per-test in-memory SQLite engine with a persistent connection using StaticPool.

methods.name: Generator[Session,None,None] db_session(db_engine)
methods.description: Creates and yields a SQLAlchemy session bound to the in-memory database, ensuring cleanup after tests.

methods.name: Generator[TestClient,None,None] client(db_session: Session)
methods.description: Provides a FastAPI TestClient instance with dependency overrides for testing endpoints using the in-memory database.

methods.name: str _unique_email()
methods.description: Generates a unique email string for testing purposes.

methods.name: str _unique_username()
methods.description: Generates a unique username string for testing purposes.

methods.name: Dict register_user(client: TestClient, *, email: str, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Sends a POST request to register a new user via the API and returns the response details.

methods.name: Tuple[int,Dict] login_user(client: TestClient, *, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Sends a POST request to login a user via the API and returns status and JSON response.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] auth_headers(token: str)
methods.description: Creates authorization headers with a Bearer token for authenticated requests.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] user_credentials()
methods.description: Pytest fixture providing a dictionary with unique user credentials.

methods.name: User admin_user(db_session: Session)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that creates an admin user in the database for role-based testing.

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^def login_user(client: TestClient, *, username: str, password: str) -> Tuple[int, Dict]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^def register_user(client: TestClient, *, email: str, username: str, password: str) -> Dict:$/
ctags.signature: (client: TestClient, *, email: str, username: str, password: str)
